eyebrow: Scan stage pulls in the DevSecOps chapter
code:
scan:
  needs: test
  steps:
    - name: SAST
      run: semgrep ci
    - name: SCA / dependency scan
      run: trivy fs --severity CRITICAL,HIGH .
    - name: Secrets detection
      run: gitleaks detect --source .
    - name: IaC scan
      run: checkov -d infra/
caption: Severity decides whether the pipeline blocks — not which tool found the problem.

code:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
  test:
    needs: build
  scan:
    needs: test
  deploy:
    needs: scan
    steps:
      - run: yq -i '.image.tag = "${{ github.sha }}"' gitops-repo/app/values.yaml
      - run: git -C gitops-repo commit -am "deploy@${{ github.sha }}" && git -C gitops-repo push
caption: `needs:` is a hard dependency — deploy cannot start until scan reports success.
